preconditions.description: The number of files is between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 8 for name in file_names)
preconditions.description: Each file name has between 1 and 8 lowercase letters.
The number of file names matches the given number of files.

preconditions.expression: all('import' in line for line in import_lines)

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'SHIP IT' if not has_cycle else return_value != 'SHIP IT'
postconditions.description: Output 'SHIP IT' if there are no cyclic dependencies, otherwise output a shortest cycle.

postconditions.expression: if return_value != 'SHIP IT': all(file_names[i] in import_lines[file_names[i]] for i in range(len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: Each file in the output cycle imports the next file in the cycle.

postconditions.expression: if return_value != 'SHIP IT': return_value[-1] in import_lines[return_value[0]]
postconditions.description: The last file in the output cycle imports the first file in the cycle.
